title: Rabbi Ralph Tawil: "Israel, God and the Holocaust"

chapters.title: Holocaust Remembrance Day in Israel
chapters.about: Origin and commemoration of the day

chapters.title: Eli Wiesel and the question of God
Theological perspective on free will
chapters.about: Human agency and the existence of evil

summary: Rabbi Tawil discusses the commemoration of the Holocaust in Israel and explores the theological challenge of God's role during such events. He draws on Eli Wiesel's book Night to examine the nature of human free will and the survival of the Jewish people as witnesses to God's existence.
questions: Why did Israel choose the date of the Warsaw ghetto uprising for Holocaust Remembrance Day?
How can we reconcile the existence of a merciful God with the occurrence of the Holocaust?
Why does God allow humans to commit evil acts?
What is the significance of the Jewish people being called God's witnesses?
Is the mission of the Jewish people exclusive to those born Jewish?
